findings.summary: Theme does not follow the system light/dark preference
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots under default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are pixel-identical, while computed CSS reports body color-scheme: dark. The site provides a usable dark surface but imposes it rather than adapting to the preference.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light and dark palettes and select them with color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark().

findings.summary: Primary links have no visible keyboard focus indicator
findings.evidence: The focus probe programmatically focused both Access my computer and Share my screen links and read outline: none and box-shadow: none for each.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible indicator with sufficient contrast while retaining the browser outline as a fallback.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP misses the good threshold under Lighthouse throttling
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 4.2 s (performance 0.85), although the unthrottled CDP trace measured 1.48 s. This indicates a slow-network/device risk rather than a universal failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element and shorten its critical path; prioritise the hero asset and defer non-critical bundles.

findings.summary: The landing page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 201 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS. The HAR transfers 279,079 bytes of script for a simple two-action landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route-specific code, defer feedback/account chrome until requested, and remove landing-page CSS not used above the fold.

findings.summary: The page lacks semantic heading/landmark structure and visible focus
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM inspection found no h1 and no main landmark, while the focus probe found no visible outline on four primary action links.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark the hero statement as an h1, wrap primary content in main, and add a clear :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Mobile viewport configuration disables pinch zoom
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the meta-viewport accessibility audit; the DOM contains maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no so users can zoom while preserving the responsive width=device-width setting.

findings.evidence: The images primitive found two SVG logo instances without width and height attributes. No CLS occurred in this capture, but intrinsic dimensions should reserve space deterministically.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width and height matching each SVG aspect ratio, or reserve equivalent space with aspect-ratio.

findings.summary: The page is ineligible for the back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache blockers, including Cache-Control: no-store on the main resource and a modified HTTP-only cookie.
findings.suggestedFix: Where security requirements permit, avoid no-store for the public landing document and isolate state-changing cookie work from it.

findings.summary: The public landing page has no meta description
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive and Lighthouse both report that the title survives raw HTML but meta description is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise, page-specific meta description explaining remote access and screen sharing.

findings.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata
findings.summary: Share-preview and structured entity metadata are absent
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM inspection found no Open Graph or JSON-LD metadata for this public product landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and appropriate SoftwareApplication or WebApplication JSON-LD that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Security header and cookie posture has avoidable weaknesses
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no HSTS and a CSP allowlist containing unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval. Cookies included NID without Secure and both cookies used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS, remove unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline from enforceable CSP paths, and set Secure plus the narrowest viable SameSite policy on cookies.

findings.summary: Referrer policy is absent and Permissions-Policy is overly permissive
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no Referrer-Policy; Permissions-Policy only declares broad client-hint access and does not constrain sensitive browser capabilities.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy and an explicit least-privilege Permissions-Policy while retaining frame protection and Trusted Types.

findings.summary: The same-origin 404 page provides no recovery path
findings.evidence: The exercised /does-not-exist route renders only Google’s generic 404 text and an unlabeled logo link, with no Home, Access, or Support recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a product-specific 404 with clear links back to the landing page and the two primary tasks.

findings.summary: Third-party and unused script cost is high for the landing page’s scope
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes 198,704 of 509,107 transferred bytes to third-party origins, while Lighthouse estimates 201 KiB of unused JavaScript. No known tracker was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer account, feedback, and logging modules until needed and keep the unauthenticated landing payload focused on its two actions.
